title: Warm Smoky Dutch Ancho Chilli Stew
description: A comforting and smoky vegan stew featuring ancho chillies and beurre-monte, inspired by Dutch cuisine. This hearty dish is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Soak the dried ancho chillies in hot water for 20 minutes, then chop them into small pieces.
In a large pot, melt the vegan butter over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Sprinkle the flour over the onion mixture and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the vegetable broth, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Add the chopped ancho chillies, beurre-monte, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
